run_gtest_list_tests: run gtest_list_tests_unittest_ with args and return the list of tests printed
test_list_tests_default: test the default behavior of gtest_list_tests when the flag is not set
test_list_tests_flag: test gtest_list_tests flag with values 0 and 1 to verify output
test_list_tests_override: test that gtest_list_tests overrides non-filter flags like gtest_break_on_failure
test_list_tests_filter: test gtest_list_tests with gtest_filter flag to verify filtered test output
